organizations.csv: organization.organization_id (c01) is required but has 13 nulls; remediation (e.g., derive from source, skip, or backfill) will be handled during validation.

organization.lifecycle_status (c03) is required but has 44 nulls; defaults or derivation (including dormancy per rule 2) will need to be applied during cross-record validation once activity recency is available.
Per rule 2, accounts with no recorded activity in the last 18 months should be set to Inactive regardless of CRM status; this will be enforced after activity data is loaded.
Country disambiguation per rule 5 will rely on c05 (billing_region) to interpret 'CA' in c06 correctly (Canada vs California).
c07 contains 216 URLs without a scheme and 94 placeholders; scheme will be added, but placeholder detection/cleanup beyond basic formatting will be addressed at validation.

c08 and c14 contain future dates (4 and 5 respectively), which would not make sense for organization.customer_since; this supports the need to clarify which is a relationship start vs a subscription renewal/start date.

c12 has 39 malformed emails and 30 normalized duplicates; contact.email must be unique within an organization. Actual duplicates relative to organization_id will be identified and resolved during validation.
c11 includes decimal-like strings (e.g., '899.0'); these will be rounded to integers as specified.
Industry codes in c04 include numeric NAICS sector codes ('31','23'); the mapping covers these to manufacturing and construction respectively.

Rules 7–12 pertain to subscriptions and cannot be applied within this organizations dataset; if either c08 or c14 are subscription dates, they will be handled in the subscriptions load once confirmed.
contacts.csv: c01 has 22 nulls; contacts without an organization_id will fail load because contact.organization_id is required. Resolution (defaults, drops, or backfill) will be handled at validation.

c17 appears to be a single full-name field. The split rule will populate both required fields contact.first_name and contact.last_name. Shapes suggest two tokens, but any single-token edge cases (if present) will need a validation rule.

c18 includes 106 malformed emails and 240 uppercase variants; normalization is defined, but malformed addresses will need remediation during validation. Email must be unique within an organization per cross-record rules.
c19 contains no E.164 values and mixed formats; normalization requires a default country code decision (question asked).

c20 interacts with primary-contact handling: per Rule 13, CEO/Owner/Primary imply the primary contact when no explicit flag exists. Cross-record rule limits one primary contact per organization; any conflicts will be surfaced during validation.
c22 contains 8 future dates, suggesting it may be a planned/scheduled date rather than a historical timestamp; mapping is pending clarification.
Ensure organizations referenced by contact.organization_id exist before loading contacts (cross-record rule).
subscriptions.json: c28 (seats) has 41 nulls, but subscription.seats is required. Leave as-is here; the engineer will decide at validation whether to default, infer, or reject those rows.

Implement Rule 11 as a migration filter: exclude subscriptions whose status resolves to 'trial' and whose c29 start_date is older than 90 days at run time. (Assumption: c29 is the trial start; if not, confirm in the account-level dataset.)
Quarterly billing ('Q') will be converted to 'monthly' per Rule 9; no change to amounts is needed because amounts are monthly regardless of billing cycle (Rule 12).
A small number of start_date values are in the future (2) and many renewal_date values are in the future (80); ensure renewal_date > start_date during validation.

Cross-entity checks to perform later: (a) Strategic organizations must have Enterprise plan (Rule 4); (b) Inactive or churned organizations cannot hold trial or active subscriptions (platform rule). These require organization data and will be validated post-join.
activity.csv: Assumption: 'c01' is the organization/account key referenced by activities. Please ensure these values match organization.organization_id from the account import so cross-record rule 'an organization must exist before any ... activity references it' is satisfied.
Timezone assumption for c35: timestamps without an explicit timezone are treated as UTC before normalization. If these represent a local timezone, advise so we can adjust.
c36 parsing: only 1,913 values parsed as numeric; many rows are null or placeholders. The engineer will handle blanks/invalids during validation per process.
c32 carries only 'USD' when present; since activity amounts are stored in USD, we are intentionally dropping this field.
